resume.headline: Software Engineer
resume.summary: Software Engineer with 4+ years of experience shipping production web applications and data services, from PostgreSQL schemas and authentication to JavaScript interfaces deployed on Vercel. Built and operates a live inventory application that replaced 7 paper and spreadsheet logs for a small business. Holds an M.S. in Applied Computer Science and AWS Cloud Practitioner and Azure certifications.

bullets.label: Full-Stack Delivery
bullets.text: Builds and operates a production inventory web application with a JavaScript frontend, a supabase-js data layer, and a Supabase PostgreSQL backend, shipped to production on Vercel.

bullets.label: Schema Design
bullets.text: Designs PostgreSQL tables with status enums, update triggers, and indexed lookups plus an append-only history table, replacing 7 paper and spreadsheet logs.

bullets.label: Dashboard Interface
bullets.text: Implements login, dashboard, and migration pages with stat cards, a reorder schedule, per-item history views, and SheetJS Excel export for purchasing workflows.

bullets.label: Access Control
bullets.text: Implements authentication with Supabase Auth and row-level security policies on every table, applying web security basics so data stays limited to signed-in sessions.

bullets.label: Data Migrations
bullets.text: Authors data migrations for 8 legacy CSV exports, validating parsed par levels against source values and routing unparseable rows to a manual-review queue.

bullets.label: Web Application
bullets.text: Built CodeRepoReader AI, a Flask web application with REST endpoints for repository upload or GitHub URL input and conversational Q&A over the analyzed codebase.

bullets.label: Static Analyzer
bullets.text: Engineered a static analyzer for 4 languages using Python AST and regex, extracting classes, functions, dependencies, and entry points into structured context.

bullets.label: Serverless Deployment
bullets.text: Ported the service to the OpenAI SDK and deployed it on Vercel serverless functions with a per-session cache that avoids rescanning repositories on follow-up questions.

bullets.label: Data Services
bullets.text: Developed Python and SQL services that consolidated 40+ regional SQL Server sources into shared Snowflake datasets, standardizing business keys across roughly 5 million records.

bullets.label: Requirements Scoping
bullets.text: Translated business reporting requirements into source-to-target mappings, specifications, and acceptance criteria, scoping each service change before implementation began.

bullets.label: Row-Level Security
bullets.text: Implemented row-level security and scheduled refresh in Power BI so regional stakeholders saw only their own data on dependable, current dashboards.

bullets.label: Automated Validation
bullets.text: Automated source-to-target reconciliation tests that caught data defects before release, reducing recurring reporting errors by more than 90% for downstream users.

bullets.label: Release Engineering
bullets.text: Shipped code through Git and Azure DevOps with peer code reviews and automated checks, keeping pipeline code and configuration changes traceable across releases.

bullets.label: Production Support
bullets.text: Monitored production jobs with Amazon CloudWatch alerts and retries, tracing root causes in schema changes and source outages, then validated fixes before resuming operation.

bullets.label: Query Optimization
bullets.text: Optimized SQL queries and shared reporting datasets, replacing repeated calculations with reusable views so recurring and ad hoc requests ran on maintainable logic.

emails.body:
Hi Hiring Team,
Greetings of the day.

I am Vamshi Krishna, a Software Engineer with over four years of experience shipping production web applications and data services. I hold a master's degree in Applied Computer Science and am interested in the Junior Full-Stack Engineer position at Mosaic Health Apps.

At LAMA Desserts, I built and operate a live inventory application with a JavaScript frontend, Supabase Auth, and PostgreSQL tables secured with row-level security, shipped to production on Vercel. At DXC Technology, I shipped production code through Git and Azure DevOps reviews, automated validation tests, and supported services in operation. This experience aligns with your focus on designing PostgreSQL tables, implementing authentication, and shipping features to production.

I have attached my resume for your consideration. I would welcome the opportunity to learn more about this role and your team, and I look forward to hearing from you regarding the next steps in the hiring process.

Best regards,
Vamshi Krishna Balupari
